subject: general
question: The historical Grand Trunk road was developed by many rulers. What was it called during the reign of the Mauryas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarpath**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sher Shah Suri reconstructed the great Trunk Road. Sher Shah Suri was a ruler of the Indian subcontinent in 16th century AD. The Grand Trunk Road formerly known as Uttarapath, Sarak-e-Azam, Badshahi Sarak, Sarak-e-Sher Shah.
 
• The Grand Trunk Road formerly known as Uttarapath was constructed by Chandragupta Maurya of the Maurya Empire in ancient India in 333BC.
 
• It is one of Asia's oldest and longest major roads.
 
• **The great Trunk Road **runs through parts of Bangladesh, India, Pakistan and Afghanistan. The length of Grand Trunk Road is 3710 km. It was made to reduce the distance between India and Pakistan. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ashoka also known as the Ashoka The Great. He was Indian Emperor of the Maurya dynasty who ruled over almost all of the Indian subcontinent. Sarnath pillar in Varanasi and Lauria Nandangarh pillar in Champaran are the great examples of of Maurya architectures and art. The famous one being Sanchi Stupa in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The full name of the Shivaji is Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj who was an Indian Warrior king and member of the Bhonsle Maratha Clan. Chhatrapati Shivaji was one of the bravest most progressive and sensible rulers of India who is known as the father of Indian Navy. Shivaji was the first to release the importance of having our Naval force and he established a navy force at the coastline to defend the Konkan side of Maharashtra. Shivaji was born on 19 February 1630 and died on 3 April 1680 at Raigad Fort.
 
• The full name of Akbar was Abdul Fath Jalaluddin Mohammed Akbar who was the third Emperor of Mughal. Akbar success his father Humayun. He created a powerful military system and instituted effective political and social reforms. Akbar was born on 15 October 1542 and died on 27 October 1605 in Fatehpur Sikri.
